title: Smoky Beef Pho Tacos
description: A fusion of Vietnamese and Mexican flavors, these tacos bring the warm and smoky taste of pho to a crispy taco shell.
instructions: 1. Brown the ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add the Pho Spice Blend and cook for 1-2 minutes.
3. Brush taco shells with Warm Tortilla Oil and toast in the oven for 5 minutes.
4. Assemble the tacos by spooning the beef mixture into the shells, then topping with cilantro, sour cream, jalapeños, and a drizzle of Vietnamese Chili Sauce.
6. Cook beef to an internal temperature of 160°F to ensure food safety.
7. Be sure to handle the jalapeños carefully to avoid skin irritation.
8. You can customize the toppings to your liking, but these are the classic combinations for a Smoky Beef Pho Taco.
9. For an extra kick, add a few dashes of hot sauce to the beef mixture before serving.
10. To make this recipe more substantial, add some cooked rice or beans to the tacos.
11. This recipe is best served immediately, but you can also store the beef mixture in the fridge for up to a day and reheat when needed.
12. Leftover taco shells can be stored in an airtight container for up to 2 days.
